verdict.rationale: Aleph documents the pieces of a board pack. It offers 'board-ready variance analysis' and versioned forecasts (aleph-docs-3), AI-written variance commentary via Scan (aleph-docs-10), and dashboards and reports the agent can build or update (aleph-docs-7, aleph-docs-8, aleph-docs-19). It also claims to keep existing reporting packages in sync with a single source of truth (aleph-docs-1, aleph-docs-2), so the live-model angle is credible. However, no evidence shows it generating a single assembled board pack or slide deck, so pulling the parts into a pack may still be manual. Missing for 10: explicit board-pack/deck generation or slide export, a documented combined metrics+commentary+forecast package, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
